subject: Cannot compile to html since updating to 3.2

messages.author: ffc90ca80c80342c
messages.subject: Cannot compile to html since updating to 3.2
parts:
Hello Everybody, 
I just update R to 3.2 (kntir 1.9) and I'm getting the following error when compiling to html (the default new .Rmd doc):

 Error in loadNamespace(i, c(lib.loc, .libPaths()), versionCheck = vI[[i]]) : 
  there is no package called 'digest'
Calls: :: ... tryCatch -> tryCatchList -> tryCatchOne -> <Anonymous>
Execution halted

Is anybody else having this issue?
Best,

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Cannot compile to html since updating to 3.2
parts:
Did you install.packages('digest'), or just update.packages(ask =
FALSE, checkBuilt = TRUE)?

Regards,
Yihui
